title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Transfer Fee Rules
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — how a transfer fee is set and booked.**

**Clause 1 — one fee per transfer.** A transfer carries at most one fee entry. The fee is booked as its own entry pointing to the transfer, carrying the transfer's payday, delivery speed and destination, and is added to the outstanding balance to be recovered on that payday; it is never taken out of the amount delivered.

**Clause 2 — the listed fee.** *(This clause is no longer in force for the bank transfer fee: the fee of the plan's latest transfer of the day when that transfer goes next business day to a bank account and the employer's fee model leaves it payable by the worker, which the bank transfer fee schedule sets. For every other fee, the instant transfer fees among them, it is in force and reads as follows.)* The listed fee is set by speed and destination at the plan's tier: an instant transfer to an external debit card costs the tier's instant external debit card fee plus the surcharge of the tier's instant surcharge band that contains the transfer amount; an instant transfer to the Paystride Visa Payroll Card costs the tier's instant Paystride card fee; a next-business-day transfer to a bank account costs the tier's next-business-day bank fee; a next-business-day transfer to the Paystride card costs the tier's next-business-day Paystride card fee.

**Clause 3 — the adjustments.** The adjustments then apply in this order and do not add to one another.

- *First, the tier benefit:* an instant transfer whose position among the period's instant transfers (returned ones excluded, in order of entry date then daily sequence, the new transfer included) is within the tier's count of instant transfers carrying no fee carries no fee.
- *Second, the employer's fee model on the program agreement:* under the employer-paid model a transfer whose position among all of the period's transfers (returned ones excluded, the new transfer included) is within the employer-paid transfers per worker per period of the employer's program tier carries no fee to the worker, the employer paying through its per-worker monthly fee; under the employer-sponsored model a transfer whose position among all of the period's transfers (returned ones excluded, the new transfer included) is within the sponsored free transfers per worker per period of the employer's program tier carries no fee to the worker and is billed to the employer; under the worker-paid model the worker pays the listed fee.
- *Third, the period fee cap.* *(This clause is no longer in force for the bank transfer fee; for every other fee, the instant transfer fees among them, it is in force and reads as follows.)* The fee is reduced to the room left between the tier's fee ceiling per pay period and the period's fee total, so the worker's fees for a pay period never exceed the cap.

**Clause 4 — zero fee.** When the resulting fee is zero no fee entry is booked.

## The period's fee total

The fees carrying the plan's next payday less the amount of the fee reversals pointing to them.

## Hypothetical worked case (instant, external debit card)

A plan on Paystride Access Standard, worker-paid employer model, books an instant transfer of 64.25 USD to an external debit card. The listed fee is the 3.29 USD instant fee plus the 0.00 USD surcharge of the 5.00 to 100.00 USD band, 3.29 USD. The tier grants no free instant transfer. The period's fee total so far is 11.20 USD against the 12.99 USD ceiling, leaving 1.79 USD of room, so the fee booked is 1.79 USD.

| Order | Test | Effect when met |
|---|---|---|
| First | position within the tier's free instant count | no fee |
| Second | employer-paid or employer-sponsored position within the program tier's count | no fee to the worker |
| Third | room under the period fee ceiling smaller than the fee | fee reduced to the room |
